nodes.description: COUP-TFI is a major transcriptional regulator orchestrating cortical arealization, cell-type specification, and maturation across forebrain structures, and contributes to development of the retina and optic nerve. nodes.description: Heterozygous whole-gene deletions and loss-of-function variants reduce functional NR2F1 dosage. Pathogenic missense variants in the zinc-finger DNA-binding domain or ligand-binding domain reduce transcriptional activity; DNA-binding-domain variants can also interfere with wild-type dimer function and are associated with a more severe clinical phenotype. The established shared consequence is reduced functional NR2F1 transcriptional output, while the precise contribution of dominant-negative activity varies by allele.
